name: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Ltd
title: Texmaco Rail & Engineering Ltd - 533326 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Freight-car volumes fell to 8,372 in FY26 (2,196 in Q4) with revenue down 14% to ₹4,377 cr; management offered no numeric FY27 guidance and booked a ₹700 cr contingency provision, while wagon-tender timing stayed unclear.

capex.peers_comment: Management said peers have ventured into wheels; said Texmaco's entry is not to copy and that supply-demand was considered.
capex.quote: the Board has approved for INR200 crores capex for our defense business

triggers.label: Q4 freight cars 2,196; FY26 8,372
triggers.quote: we delivered 2,196 freight cars in Q4 of FY 2026

triggers.label: No numeric FY27 guidance
triggers.quote: We cannot be too specific for a forward-looking statement.

triggers.label: ₹700 cr contingency provision
triggers.quote: the company has created a provisions for contingencies of INR700 crores from its free results

triggers.label: Large Indian wagon tender still awaited
triggers.quote: We have not seen any carving out.

triggers.label: South Africa order ~₹4,000 cr
triggers.quote: we had seen some major order wins, including Cameroon, now South Africa

guidance.value: Growth in revenue and profit expected, not quantified
guidance.quote: we definitely envisage a growth in terms of top line and very good achievement in terms of growth in the bottom line also

guidance.value: Top line to grow at least 2x; EBITDA margin mid-teens and above
guidance.quote: we, as a company wants to grow in the top line at least 2x

guidance.value: ₹1,500 cr to ₹2,000 cr; ₹200 cr defence approved
guidance.quote: we can predict a range of INR1,500 crores to INR2,000 crores as of now

red_flags.label: Auditor qualification over ₹700 cr provision
red_flags.quote: the statutory auditors have thus qualified their report

red_flags.label: Vague answers on capex, orders and margins
red_flags.quote: we cannot predict a specific number

evasions.quote: We cannot be too specific for a forward-looking statement.
We have not seen any carving out.

evasions.topic: South Africa order margin and locomotive sourcing
evasions.quote: So it's a complete solution providing contract right from design to maintain the whole life cycle
So it's a kind of a mixed answer I do not have right now.
